confirmed_software_failure_path: Runtime prepeek of a complete post-PARAM Withdrawn invoked Stop-R19GrantReservationWorkflow before removing the parsed frame from the runtime monitor. The monitor then retained that complete frame while next_raw_offset already covered all bytes. With no newer native bytes, its early return could indefinitely defer terminal preflight's buffer-empty condition.
